description_ar: أسئلة مباشرة حول الأفعال التي يليها V-ing أو to + V1

questions.memorization_note: أفعال تأتي بعدها $V\text{-ing}$: $\text{enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, suggest, keep, practise, consider, can't help}$.

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: to find. decide + to + V1.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: to find. decide + to + V1.
questions.memorization_note: أفعال تأتي بعدها $\text{to} + V_1$: $\text{want, hope, decide, plan, need, agree, refuse, promise, manage, afford, learn}$.
أفعال تأتي بعدها $V\text{-ing}$: $\text{enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, suggest, keep, practise, consider, can't help}$.

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: to see. hope + to + V1.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: to see. hope + to + V1.
questions.memorization_note: أفعال تأتي بعدها $\text{to} + V_1$: $\text{want, hope, decide, plan, need, agree, refuse, promise, manage, afford, learn}$.

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: seeing. 'to' here is a preposition, so V-ing follows.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: seeing. to هنا حرف جر ← V-ing.
questions.memorization_note: بعد حرف الجر دائماً $V\text{-ing}$ ، و $\text{look forward to}$ و $\text{be used to}$ و $\text{It's no use}$ كلها $+ V\text{-ing}$ ($\text{to}$ هنا حرف جر).

questions.question_en: They stopped ___ because they were tired.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: working. stop + V-ing = quit the activity.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: working. stop + V-ing = التوقف عن الفعل.
questions.memorization_note: تغير المعنى: $\text{stop} + V\text{-ing}$ (توقف عن) / $\text{stop to} + V_1$ (توقف ليفعل) ، $\text{remember to} + V_1$ (مستقبل) / $\text{remember} + V\text{-ing}$ (ماضٍ).

questions.question_en: He stopped ___ a coffee on the way.
questions.question_ar: هو توقف ليأخذ ____ قهوة في الطريق.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: to have. stop + to + V1 = stopped in order to do something.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: to have. stop + to + V1 = توقف ليفعل شيئاً.
questions.memorization_note: تغير المعنى: $\text{stop} + V\text{-ing}$ (توقف عن) / $\text{stop to} + V_1$ (توقف ليفعل) ، $\text{remember to} + V_1$ (مستقبل) / $\text{remember} + V\text{-ing}$ (ماضٍ).

questions.question_en: Remember ___ the door when you leave.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: to lock. remember + to + V1 = a future duty.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: to lock. remember + to + V1 = واجب مستقبلي.
questions.memorization_note: تغير المعنى: $\text{stop} + V\text{-ing}$ (توقف عن) / $\text{stop to} + V_1$ (توقف ليفعل) ، $\text{remember to} + V_1$ (مستقبل) / $\text{remember} + V\text{-ing}$ (ماضٍ).
